freeLine: Look around without an account. With a free account, you can make 3 worksheets a month.
appAlt: The {name} maker with its worksheets, levels and picture themes
ogTagline: Print it or play it on screen, ready in a minute
proofPicturesBody: Change the theme and every picture on the page changes.
proofLanguagesBody: Written for each language, not translated by a machine.
proofTwoWaysBody: Print a PDF, or let children do it on a screen.
proofPaperBody: Print a clean PDF, ready for the copier.
proofShareBody: Keep what you make and send it by link or QR code.
wallTitle: All {count} worksheets you can make here
wallBody: Choose one to open it in the maker. Each comes in three levels where the skill allows, with new versions as often as you need.
howTitle: Ready to print in about a minute
step1Body: Every worksheet in this maker is a click away, with a real sample of each.
step2Body: Set the level, choose a picture theme and click any picture, word or title on the page to change it.
step2BodyPlain: Set the level and click any word or title on the page to change it.
step3Body: Download the PDF with its answer key, or send children the screen version by link.
step3BodyPaper: Download a clean PDF and print as many copies as you need.
libraryBody: Choose from a large library of reviewed pictures, in color or black and white. Switch the language, and the words, the instructions and the page follow.
libraryBodyPlain: Switch the language, and the words, the instructions and the page follow, written for how children learn in that language.
plansBody: When you want to make more, one plan opens every maker and everything else on the site.
planFree3: Look at every template in every maker
planPaid1: Make as many worksheets as you like
planPaid3: Save your worksheets and come back to them
planPaid4: Share with your class by link or QR code
faqFreeQ: Can I use this worksheet maker for free?
faqFreeA: Yes. You can look at all {count} worksheets without an account. A free account lets you make 3 new worksheets and download 1 PDF a month. The Teacher plan removes those limits.
faqGradesA: The worksheets here are made for: {grades}. Where a worksheet has levels, you can move it up or down to fit each child.
faqKeyAll: Yes. Every worksheet in this maker comes with an answer key.
faqKeySome: Yes. {keys} of the {count} worksheets here have an answer key. The others are drawing, tracing or open tasks with no single right answer.
faqKeyNone: These worksheets are tracing, drawing or open tasks, so they have no answer key.
faqScreenQ: Can children do these worksheets on a screen?
faqScreenAll: Yes. All {count} worksheets also work on screen, where children tap, drag or type and see if they are right.
faqScreenSome: Yes. {screens} of the {count} worksheets also work on screen, where children tap, drag or type and see if they are right. They carry the mark “Also on screen” above.
faqScreenNone: Not these. They are made for pencil and paper, so children trace, draw or write by hand.
faqLangA: This maker works in {languages}. Each language has its own words and school conventions.
faqSaveQ: Can I save my worksheets and share them?
faqSaveA: Yes, with the Teacher plan. You keep your worksheets in your account, come back to change them, and share them with your class by link or QR code. Children need no account.
seeAllBody: From counting to cursive, all in one place.
